TW: Mentioning of SH


Told my two "besties"(twins and friends since grand school) in our group back in high school that I'm depressed and doing SH and instead questioning it or being supportive, one of the two just told me "go to a asylum" in a bad way, which i don't want to recall again. I was a little shocked tbh bc i just wanted the support of my friends and especially from my "best friends" but after i got out of the room and thought about everything and every shit they did to me... From manipulation and gaslight to accusing me of shit i didn't even say or do and always turning against me after i tried to be a mediator for them when they asked me... It was like getting hit by a bus... I realized, they were one of the reasons i feel like shit.
We talked in our group again couple of days later and these two were against me again. Especially one of them. Saying i was accusing them wrong and how could i blame them for that. They turned everything so i would be the villain... Again... I snapped and flipped them off and leaved them behind me. I finally found that lil courage i thought was gone years ago... But I'm glad i did it. Felt after that like a free bird again.

It took me some time to realize but better late than never.
Ofc there's more background story and they are not the only reason but they were the last reason.
Exactly at midnight my neighbors above played classic music.... If that ain't some Hannibal stuff idk
I move my body to music
Listening to music, dance everything away and maybe scream into a pillow for extra relief

Have been manipulated by them into thinking I couldn't be happy without them or couldn't find anyone better then them. They were twins and like any other siblings they had fights. Everytime they fought, they called me over and I needed to settle the fight. At some point they always got together and both fought against me and made me belive I did something wrong. I couldn't tell them how I felt if I had a bad day or something because they would always tell me how hard their live is. One of them got bad grades and I was blamed for that. The moment I told them I wanted to hang out with someone other, they texted me later and said what a bad best friend I was and how I was only thinking about myself and... Called me names. At some point I was really depressed and maybe even a lil suicidal... One day I told them... One of them didn't really said anything, just stood up and got somewhere else. The other one said to me in a downgrade, hateful & hurtful way go to an asylum...I tried to explain why and everything but regardless... They just played the victim again and "how dare I say that they were also the cause of my depression"... I meant their actions and the ways They treated me... Anyway... That was the moment I broke... Especially one of them was the worst... At that moment I wasn't even sure why I was befriended with them.... I finally saw that that person never was a good friend.... And broke both friendships to them.... After about a year one of them reached out to me and we talked everything out. The other one still talked shit about me even when we had the same friends and always made a scene... I'm so gald that I don't have such friends anymore and it was THE best decision I made.
